newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Siddons sees higher year profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Siddons sees higher year profit.

text.p: Hardware, tools and fasteners manufacturer Siddons Ramset Ltd said on Tuesday that it expected profits for the year to June 1997 to exceed those achieved in the 1996 financial year.

"With the current mix of the group's businesses and no adverse changes in economic conditions in the company's major markets, directors expect the full year will exceed (financial year) 1996," Siddons said in a statement accompanying half year results.
Siddons reported a net profit of A$11.70 million for the six months to December, up from A$10.15 million a year earlier.
Sales rose 12 percent to A$151 million for the period.

"Slightly lower Ramset divisional sales in Australia and New Zealand affected these operations, while further development expenses in Asia restricted the anticipated growth in profits in this area," the company said.
